context: Rootless native Apple probe after PR #47 merged into main and that main was merged into the M1 Stax pilot branch.
method: Run topdown apple probe --mode m1 with DEVELOPER_DIR scoped to the command, then use public apple store, query and report commands on a fresh SQLite database.
limitations: The native vector position-to-event mapping, loss, sampling rate, and TMA formulas remain unverified. This probe is a functional and storage regression check, not a Stax capture or PMU comparison. The Stax v3 archive does not preserve its raw kdebug CPU ID, even though this separate native Xcode profile has per-sample core labels.
